grammatica.evidence: Elevated essay register with parallel loanword-lists as subjects and antithesis frames: 'A smörgåsbord is not quite a buffet, a fjord is not quite a bay'; 'A señora is not a senora'; semicolon/em-dash compounding throughout.

dialectica.evidence: Why-chain: 'borrows faster than it naturalises' → façade 'last part to erode' → food 'further than philosophy' because 'not translatable' → accents 'not decoration' but 'passport' of remembered origin.

rhetorica.evidence: Curated clusters ordered present→history→food→moral: café/jalapeño/résumé; Greek λόγος/τέχνη; sputnik/perestroika; phở/bánh mì/pączki/açaí/şiş; minimal pairs señora, über, garçon — from a vast loanword option space.

arithmetica.evidence: Public facts as claims: named loanwords retain diacritics; Greek/Russian/Viet/Polish/Turkish origins; sputnik/perestroika; smörgåsbord≠buffet; plus few non-lookup lines ('borrows faster', 'food further than philosophy', passport).

geometria.evidence: Single H1 title-claim then four continuous prose paragraphs; no subheads, lists, or multi-section hierarchy — default short-essay page shape.

musica.evidence: Local cadence via tricola and anaphora: 'résumé, cliché, entrée and protégé'; triple 'not quite'; closing maxim after paired antitheses ('señora… über… garçon') ending on em-dash 'passport'.

astronomia.evidence: Arc: familiar EN café/jalapeño hook → pre-press Greek/Russian widening → food peak (phở…şiş) → thesis landing 'None of this is decoration… passport' — amplify-then-epigram trajectory.

notes: Explains via curated non-ASCII examples more than explicit linguistic mechanism; public substrate makes word-facts Stock while the passport frame is Selected.
